About

24 years of strategic storytelling

“Her personal experiences have given her a deeply human perspective on perseverance, identity and emotional resilience.”
— Speaker Bio, Red Jacket Speakers Bureau

Prinella Pillay is a communications strategist, media specialist and PR professional with more than 24 years of experience across journalism, corporate communications and strategic storytelling in South Africa and Sub-Saharan Africa — from newsrooms and hospitality brands to agency leadership on accounts like Jaguar Land Rover, McDonald’s SA and Tata.

In 2019, she founded High Note Media (Pty) Ltd, built on a simple motto: “We tell your story. We elevate your impact.” Shaped as much by resilience and reinvention as by professional accomplishment, she brings an authentic, relatable voice to communication, reinvention and the evolving media landscape.
